description: Batch 9: flag grammars. A short POSIX cluster is matched case-sensitively and a PowerShell parameter is matched as a whole word; -r names code only for a runtime head. The measured defect: /^-[a-z]*r[a-z]*$/i read 'this argument contains the letter r' as 'this is recursive', so every PowerShell parameter word was a recursive flag and -Force was recursive and force at once.
